title: A Lost Wallet at the Night Market
passage:
Tom and his sister Amy go to the night market every Thursday evening. The night market, which is near their house, sells many kinds of delicious food and cheap clothes.
Tonight, Amy wants to buy a bubble tea, but when she opens her bag, she can't find her wallet. "Oh no! My wallet is missing!" she says, feeling very nervous.
Tom tells her, "Don't panic. If we ask the stall owners, they will help us look for it." They walk back to the stalls they visited and ask each owner carefully.
At the last stall, the owner who sells fried chicken smiles and says, "A wallet was found by a kind customer a few minutes ago. It is kept at the information booth now." Amy feels relieved and runs to the booth.
The wallet, which contains her ID card and some cash, is returned to her safely. "Thank you so much!" Amy says happily.
Tom laughs and says, "If you keep your wallet in your pocket next time, you won't lose it again!" They walk through the crowded night market together, enjoying the bright lights and delicious smells.

grammar: 關係代詞 who / which 引導形容詞子句：who 修飾人，which 修飾事物，用來補充說明前面的名詞，如 The night market, which is near their house, sells many kinds of food. / The owner who sells fried chicken smiles and says...
被動語態 (be + 過去分詞)：強調動作的承受者而非執行者時使用，如 A wallet was found by a kind customer. / The wallet is kept at the information booth now.
第一條件句 (if + 現在簡單式, 主詞 + will + 原形動詞)：表示現實中可能發生的情況與其結果，如 If we ask the stall owners, they will help us look for it. / If you keep your wallet in your pocket, you won't lose it again.

reading.q: Why can't Amy buy a bubble tea at first?
reading.ex: Amy 打開包包時發現錢包不見了，所以沒辦法買珍珠奶茶，答案為 B。

reading.q: What does Tom suggest they do to find the wallet?
opts: Go home and look for it
reading.ex: Tom 說「If we ask the stall owners, they will help us look for it.」，建議去問攤位老闆，答案為 C。

opts: The fried chicken stall owner's daughter
reading.ex: 文章提到「A wallet was found by a kind customer a few minutes ago.」，是一位好心的顧客找到的，答案為 C。

reading.q: Where is the wallet kept after it was found?
reading.ex: 文章提到錢包「is kept at the information booth now」，答案為 B。

reading.q: What does Tom advise Amy to do next time?
opts: Keep her wallet in her pocket
Ask a stranger to hold her wallet
reading.ex: Tom 最後說「If you keep your wallet in your pocket next time, you won't lose it again!」，答案為 B。

grammar.q: The night market, ______ is near their house, sells many kinds of food.
grammar.ex: which 引導形容詞子句修飾事物（night market），並補充說明其位置，答案為 B。

grammar.q: The owner ______ sells fried chicken smiles and says...
grammar.ex: who 引導形容詞子句修飾人（the owner），答案為 C。

grammar.q: A wallet ______ by a kind customer a few minutes ago.
grammar.ex: 被動語態 be + 過去分詞，強調錢包被找到這個動作的承受者，答案為 C。

grammar.q: If we ask the stall owners, they ______ us look for it.
grammar.ex: 第一條件句：if + 現在簡單式，主要子句用 will + 原形動詞，答案為 C。

grammar.q: If you keep your wallet in your pocket, you ______ it again.
grammar.ex: 第一條件句的否定形式，won't + 原形動詞表示「將不會」，答案為 A。

vocab.q: Amy felt very ______ when she couldn't find her wallet.
vocab.ex: nervous 意為「緊張的」，符合找不到錢包時的心情，答案為 B。
panic 意為「恐慌、驚慌」，答案為 A。

vocab.q: The night market is always ______ on Thursday evenings.
vocab.ex: crowded 意為「擁擠的」，用來形容夜市人多的樣子，答案為 B。
return 意為「歸還」，答案為 B。

vocab.q: You can ask for help at the ______ if you lose something at the night market.
vocab.ex: information booth 意為「服務台」，可在此尋求協助，答案為 B。
